pinned_interface.new_primitive_block:
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# vlib_profiles_map_roles <profiles-doc> <agf-doc>
#
# Phase-014 feature 109 (NDEBT-026): the mapping-direction primitive behind
# validate.sh check C15. Parses the profiles doc's Section 2 table (the table
# headed '| Capability Profile') and fails (return 1) unless each of the five
# profile rows names its own role in an explicit 'Role' column AND that role
# is defined in the AGF doc. A table without a 'Role' column fails with a
# line naming 'Role'. Every failure line this primitive prints starts with
# 'vlib_profiles_map_roles: '. The token-presence primitive
# vlib_profiles_cover_roles is deliberately NOT tightened in place: a direct
# caller on a role-less profiles doc keeps passing (that compatibility guard
# is feature 109 acceptance test 3, green at base by design).
#
# Args:
#   profiles-doc: standard/capability_profiles.md (the 5 profiles + Role col).
#   agf-doc:      standard/AGF.md (where the 5 roles are defined).
#
# Returns:
#   0 if every profile row names its own role and each role is AGF-defined.
#   1 otherwise (each gap is printed, prefixed 'vlib_profiles_map_roles: ').
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

vlib_profiles_map_roles() {
  local profiles_doc="$1"
  local agf_doc="$2"

  [ -f "${profiles_doc}" ] || { echo "vlib_profiles_map_roles: profiles doc not found: ${profiles_doc}"; return 1; }
  [ -f "${agf_doc}" ] || { echo "vlib_profiles_map_roles: AGF doc not found: ${agf_doc}"; return 1; }

  python3 - "${profiles_doc}" "${agf_doc}" <<'PY'
import re
import sys

profiles_path, agf_path = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]

# The same five-profile -> five-role correspondence vlib_profiles_cover_roles
# guards by token presence; this primitive instead parses the Section 2
# table's explicit Role column, so a swapped mapping fails here even though
# every named role is AGF-defined.
ROLE_BY_PROFILE = {
    "orchestrator-primary": "Orchestrator",
    "planner-creative": "Planner",
    "generator-deterministic": "Generator",
    "validator-structural": "Validator",
    "evaluator-adversarial": "Evaluator",
}


def fail(message):
    print("vlib_profiles_map_roles: " + message)


def read(path):
    with open(path, encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        return fh.read()


def has_word(text, word):
    return re.search(r"\b" + re.escape(word) + r"\b", text) is not None


try:
    profiles_text = read(profiles_path)
    agf_text = read(agf_path)
except OSError as exc:
    fail(f"cannot read: {exc}")
    sys.exit(1)

sectioned = profiles_text.split("## 2.", 1)
if len(sectioned) != 2:
    fail(f"profiles doc {profiles_path} has no '## 2.' section")
    sys.exit(1)
lines = [ln for ln in sectioned[1].split("## 3.", 1)[0].splitlines() if ln.startswith("|")]
header = next((ln for ln in lines if ln.startswith("| Capability Profile")), None)
if header is None:
    fail(f"profiles doc {profiles_path} Section 2 has no table headed '| Capability Profile'")
    sys.exit(1)
columns = [cell.strip() for cell in header.split("|")]
if "Role" not in columns:
    fail(f"profiles doc {profiles_path} Section 2 table has no 'Role' column")
    sys.exit(1)
role_col = columns.index("Role")

rows = {}
for ln in lines[1:]:
    cells = [cell.strip() for cell in ln.split("|")]
    name = cells[1] if len(cells) > 2 else ""
    if name.startswith("`") and name.endswith("`"):
        rows[name.strip("`")] = cells

gaps = []
for profile, role in ROLE_BY_PROFILE.items():
    cells = rows.get(profile)
    if cells is None:
        gaps.append(f"profiles doc {profiles_path} Section 2 table has no row for profile '{profile}'")
        continue
    found = cells[role_col] if role_col < len(cells) else ""
    if found != role:
        gaps.append(
            f"profile '{profile}' row names role '{found}', expected its own role '{role}'"
        )
    elif not has_word(agf_text, role):
        gaps.append(
            f"AGF doc {agf_path} does not define role '{role}' that profile '{profile}' maps to"
        )

if gaps:
    for gap in gaps:
        fail(gap)
    sys.exit(1)
sys.exit(0)
PY
}

check_c15_capability_profile_roles() {
  local out out2
  if out=$(vlib_profiles_cover_roles standard/capability_profiles.md standard/AGF.md 2>&1) \
    && out2=$(vlib_profiles_map_roles standard/capability_profiles.md standard/AGF.md 2>&1); then
    echo "[C15] PASS capability-profile-roles"
    return 0
  fi
  echo "[C15] FAIL capability-profile-roles"
  printf '%s\n' "${out}" "${out2:-}" | sed 's/^/  /'
  return 1

design_notes.serialization: Do not run tools/validate.sh and tools/fixtures_self_test.sh at the same time, in this tree or in one scratch copy. S05 starts with a /proc refusal (exit 4) and then runs its four scratch cases one at a time, followed by the direct (no-scratch) legacy-doc case. scratch_run copies the whole tree (including untracked .nizam/ and .git) and never writes the real tree; do not take a scratch copy while either script is running in the source tree. AT2 and AT4 are themselves scratch_run/direct invocations; do not overlap them with AT5, AT6, or S05. One capture at a time, foreground, each capture prefixed by its invocation line.
hazards: 1. AT3 is green at base BY DESIGN and must stay green: vlib_profiles_cover_roles is not tightened (doing so would be a MAJOR-class narrowing under methodology/06_release_train.md Section 3.1). Its region of verify_lib.sh is byte-identical; S04 reconstructs and diffs the region. A reviewer who expects AT3 to be red at base is wrong.

2. The untracked .nizam/ directory (~238 files, stale v1.4.0 dogfood payload) is never in scope. scratch_run copies it into scratch trees (measured: 'test -d .nizam' in a scratch copy exits 0); the sweep is unaffected (AT5 is green in the real tree that carries it; C9 exempts .nizam/ tokens by design). Do not run S03 in a tree with untracked .nizam/ -- git status --untracked-files=all would flag every .nizam/ path as outside scope. The attempt worktree from <B> has none.

3. Every phase-014 contract so far has burned attempts: 106 revision 0 failed on a Generator edit of run_state (S02), 107 attempt 1 died on the S01 flag-state contract_defect. S01 here accepts both flag states from the start, and S02/S03 carry the 106 lesson. Do not burn an attempt on either.

4. The feature description says validate.sh's --help text states a swapped mapping is out of scope. Measured at <A>: false -- there is no C15 help paragraph at all, and one must not be invented (feature 108 owns C14-C16 help paragraphs). Only the README row carries the claim. The contract pins the --help text byte-identical and updates the comment block + README row. Treating this as a defect to 'fix' by editing --help would collide with 108's scope and fail S04.

5. Evidence files: line 1 is the invocation, the body is raw combined output, the last line is EXIT:<code> from the process. No '| tee' and no '| grep' on a capture. A later edit invalidates the captures.

6. The C15 call site must short-circuit so the old primitive's output is still printed on failure (diagnostics preserved) and so a missing new primitive fails closed (set -euo pipefail context: an undefined vlib_profiles_map_roles inside $( ) makes the assignment fail, the && fails, C15 FAILs).

7. The pinned failure messages of the new primitive are load-bearing: AT4 greps '^vlib_profiles_map_roles: .*Role' (satisfied by the no-Role-column line), S05 case 1 pins the two swapped-role detail lines verbatim, and S05 case 3 pins the Orchestrator-membership line. Do not reword them in implementation.
8. C8 acts only on version differences; AT2's body-only swap cannot trip it. Do not 'fix' anything about C8.

failure_triage.DEFECT: An acceptance or S failure caused by the Generator's files. Repair inside the attempt budget: attempt 1 direct fix, attempt 2 type or interface analysis, attempt 3 architectural review. Attempt 4 is forbidden.
failure_triage.CONTRACT_DEFECT: A pin or an S check that a correct implementation cannot satisfy -- including a Validator holding the --help premise against this contract, a C1/C2/C8 failure on the unchanged capability_profiles.md outside the pinned edits, or the fixtures self-test turning red for a reason other than the pinned insertion. Halt, report, and propose a revision of this contract. Do not edit an acceptance test. Do not edit --help (feature 108's scope).

import json, os, subprocess, sys
bad = []

def serial_guard():
    ancestors, pid = set(), os.getpid()
    while pid > 1:
        ancestors.add(pid)
        try:
            pid = int(open("/proc/%d/stat" % pid).read().rsplit(")", 1)[1].split()[1])
        except (OSError, ValueError, IndexError):
            break
    for name in filter(str.isdigit, os.listdir("/proc")):
        if int(name) in ancestors:
            continue
        try:
            argv = [part.decode() for part in open("/proc/%s/cmdline" % name, "rb").read().split(b"\0") if part]
            cwd = os.readlink("/proc/%s/cwd" % name)
        except OSError:
            continue
        if cwd == os.getcwd() and len(argv) > 1 and os.path.basename(argv[0]) in ("bash", "sh") and argv[1].endswith(("tools/fixtures_self_test.sh", "tools/validate.sh")):
            print("REFUSED (exit 4): process %s is already running %s in this tree" % (name, argv[1]))
            sys.exit(4)

serial_guard()
pins = json.load(open(".agent/contracts/109.json"))["design_notes"]["pinned_interface"]

SWAP = pins["swap_mutate"]
ALL_ORCH = pins["all_orchestrator_mutate"]

    "assert t.count(old)==1, t.count(old); "
    "p.write_text(t.replace(old,new,1))"
)
SR = [sys.executable, ".agent/evidence/phase-014-activation/gates/scratch_run.py"]
VAL = ["bash", "tools/validate.sh"]
CASES = [
    ("AT2 mutation: the swapped planner<->generator mapping fails C15 via the new primitive",
     ["--py-mutate", SWAP], 1,
     [r"^\[C15\] FAIL capability-profile-roles$",
      r"^  vlib_profiles_map_roles: profile 'planner-creative' row names role 'Generator', expected its own role 'Planner'$",
      r"^  vlib_profiles_map_roles: profile 'generator-deterministic' row names role 'Planner', expected its own role 'Generator'$"],
     [r"^\[C15\] PASS", r"^  vlib_profiles_cover_roles:"], VAL),
    ("silencing the new primitive's failure path removes the C15 FAIL; the old primitive still passes",
     ["--py-mutate", SWAP, "--py-mutate", ABLATION_MUTATE], 0,
     [r"^SUMMARY: 16 passed, 0 failed$", r"^\[C15\] PASS capability-profile-roles$"],
     [r"^\[C15\] FAIL", r"^  vlib_profiles_map_roles:"], VAL),
    ("every row mapped to Orchestrator (an AGF-defined role) still fails: correspondence, not membership",
     ["--py-mutate", ALL_ORCH], 1,
     [r"^\[C15\] FAIL capability-profile-roles$",
      r"^  vlib_profiles_map_roles: profile 'evaluator-adversarial' row names role 'Orchestrator', expected its own role 'Evaluator'$",
      r"^  vlib_profiles_map_roles: profile 'planner-creative' row names role 'Orchestrator', expected its own role 'Planner'$"],

]

def one(case):
    name, mutations, rc, expects, forbids, command = case
    argv = SR + mutations + ["--expect-rc", str(rc)]
    for pattern in expects:
        argv += ["--expect", pattern]
    for pattern in forbids:
        argv += ["--forbid", pattern]
    argv += ["--"] + command
    proc = subprocess.run(argv, capture_output=True, text=True)
    print(("PASS " if proc.returncode == 0 else "FAIL ") + name)
    if proc.returncode != 0:
        print("\n".join("    " + line for line in (proc.stdout + proc.stderr).splitlines()[-25:]))
        bad.append(name)

for case in CASES:

import tempfile
tmp = tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile("w", suffix=".md", delete=False)
tmp.write(doc)
